sections.title: Bringing Unit 21 together
sections.content: This lesson pulls together Unit 21: naming your profession with no article before vagyok/van, saying where you work with -ban/-ben (or -on/-en/-ön for egyetemen), naming your employer with -nál/-nél, marking how many hours you work with the accusative, and adding a possessive suffix to who you have to do something with kell + a personal infinitive.

sections.title: Work, recapped
rows: Who do you work for? – I work for a company.
I work eight hours per day.
I have to work, I don't have a day off today.

items.english: I'm a teacher, at a school in Budapest.

items.spanish: Zsófia egy kórházban dolgozik, mert orvos.
items.english: Zsófia works in a hospital, because she's a doctor.

items.spanish: A munkatársam nagyon segítőkész, és a főnököm tapasztalt.
items.english: My colleague is very helpful, and my boss is experienced.

sections.content: Keep Hol dolgozol? (the physical place, -ban/-ben) apart from Kinél dolgozol? (the employer, -nál/-nél) — and remember dolgozik is an -ik verb, so dolgozom, not dolgozok.
